row:
Studying for the Veterinary Technician National Examination (VTNE) is incredibly challenging—but you don't have to navigate it alone. Whether you are looking to review anesthetic drugs, memorize equine parasites, or get a better understanding of how x-rays work, this channel is designed to help you study smarter, not harder. 

As an educator in a Vet Tech program, I use these lessons to support students both in the classroom and online. This channel brings those lessons to you so you can listen or watch at your own pace at home. I truly hope you pass your VTNE and find a fulfilling career, the industry needs amazing people like you!
